notes.title: Post-Release Update 1.5
notes.content:
- Audio adjustments are a bit more radical now. Going up/down by 80% instead of 50%.
- The game has not been tested in VR and it has come to my attention that starting up the game while VR-devices are connected brings up some weird issues. I have now disabled everything that has anything to do with VR (at least for now) just to see if this would fix the issue.
- Changed the labels of difficulty to "Hard" and "Madness" (from "Normal" and "Madness") to highlight the fact that the game is pretty damn hard even on the regular difficulty.

notes.title: Post-Release Update 1.3 - 1.4
notes.content:
[i]Last two patches explained. Couple new things and some tunefish![/i]

[h3][b]Underponder 1.4[/b][/h3]
[i](28.12.2020)[/i]

- Options: VSync added. Can be toggled on/off.
- Main Level Console: Added some tiny clues about the master password.

[h3][b]Underponder 1.3[/b][/h3]
[i](24.12.2020)[/i]

- Gameplay: Headbobbing reduced by 50% when walking or running.
- Audio: Music volume in "Intro" has been taken down a notch.
- Audio: The volume of footsteps decreased by 60% for walking and by 50% for running.
- System requirements: Recommended RAM changed to 16 GB (down from 32 GB).
- Achievements: "Beta Tester!"-achievement was meant to be hidden but even the hidden achievements are shown on Steam and only the "how" is unknown. Therefore "Beta Tester!"-achievement has now been replaced with "What is this?!"-achievement.
- Main Level: Hidden sanity points at start increased from 75 to 100 to avoid confusion. Players can now more safely come to the conclusion that it's the 4th mushroom that usually kills the character (instead of "[i]maybe the 3rd but in some cases the 4th one"[/i]).
